thread:
maya: kicking off the 23.4.1 release window now — rolling to prod in eu-west and us-central. watch the SLO dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/releases/23.4.1 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy started by maya for service: runtime-api version: v23.4.1-rc3 -> rolling to prod. Estimated 12m. Monitors attached: slo-prod-p95, error-rate, 5xx-rate, kvcache-latency.

raj: pinging to confirm smoke checks are in the preflight list. specifically: embed route p95, auth-5xx, and kv-cache tail latency?

maya: yes. smoke set: auth 5xx < 0.5%, embed p95 < 220ms, kv-tail p99 < 400ms. if any trips -> pause and assess.

ops-sarah: added runbook link and quick commands to thread: https://confluence.redwood/operators/deploys/runbook-release-guard. Sample rollback: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime-api runtime-api=registry/redwood/runtime:v23.4.0 --namespace=prod`

kevin: I pushed a minor config tweak for batching that landed in rc3 — watch token throughput spike. I can revert config via k8s if we see headroom issues.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic shifted to 10% at 1748604425 — no alerts so far.

raj: seeing a small bump in embed 5xx in eu-west, ~0.8% for last 2m. Not yet breaching the pause threshold but heading up. @ops-sarah any visibility on recent infra noise?

ops-sarah: checking logs — a node in eu-west-2 had transient nvlink errors around 1748604416, autoscaler rescheduled a pod. spike likely correlated. I'm scaling an extra replica in that AZ.

maya: ramp hold rule: if 5xx > 1% for >3m OR p95 degrades 30% over baseline -> pause and pin back to v23.4.0. we're at 0.8% now, continue watching.

deploy-bot: Canary shifted to 30% at 1748604480. Canary health: degraded_error_rate=0.9% (threshold=1.0%), p95=235ms (+6% vs baseline).

raj: p95 creeping but still OK. suggest we keep canary at 30% for another 4m to observe.

kevin: I'm going to temporarily lower batching size to avoid amplification of the transient error. Pushing config...

ops-sarah: config change applied in eu-west replica set. rolling restart in that AZ started.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 1748604550 due to decorrelated 5xx spike across two AZs. Pause reason: canary_guard:error_rate_crossaz. Current canary traffic: 30%.

maya: good catch. hold here. let's not continue shift. Rollback decision criteria: if we can't restore error rate <1% within 10m, we'll roll back to v23.4.0. Otherwise, we can try targeted fix and reattempt.

raj: logs show upstream embed cache returning 502 for a thin subset of requests — looks transient but repeatable under a small QPS burst. cc @kevin since batching tweak went in.

kevin: reverting my batching tweak now (rolling restart). command: `kubectl rollout restart rs/runtime-api-rc3 -n prod --grace-period=30`

ops-sarah: eu-west rolling restart finished. monitoring.

deploy-bot: Canary resumed health checks at 1748604595. error_rate now 0.4% over the last 30s, p95 210ms.

maya: status: error rate stabilized under threshold, no widespread infra failures. I'm going to pin rollout at 30% and wait for an additional 6m before completing full shift. Keep eyes on kv-tail p99 and embed 5xx.

raj: sounds good. if we see a repeat within that window, I recommend immediate rollback.

kevin: noted. I'll stand by to revert image if needed.

deploy-bot: Final shift to 100% scheduled in 6m if no further alerts.

maya: thanks all — documenting the incident notes in the runbook and will add postmortem bullet if needed. :thumbsup:

ops-sarah: added a quick note about the nvlink transient node — infra team will open a follow-up ticket.

raj: closing watch for now, will reopen if signals trend. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy completed at 1748604600 — final status: success (rolled to 100%).
